title: Dynamical Memory Transformer: Selective Recurrent Memories with Constant Cost Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.41850v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformers retain an explicit history of the sequence, allowing attention to directly retrieve past representations. However, the size of the KV-Cache and the cost of a new token increase with the context length. State Space Models compress the past into a fixed-size recurrent state, at the cost of reduced addressability. We present the Dynamical Memory Transformer (DMT), a hybrid architecture that separates sequence encoding from information reading. The encoder uses several memory units, each implemented by a dynamical system with a complex diagonal recurrent matrix. An input-dependent leak rate controls their updates. The decoder then uses attention to read and combine their outputs, without going through the token history. The formulation of the recurrence allows an associative scan with O(T ) total work and O(log T ) parallel depth, with fixed dimensions. translated_title: 动态记忆Transformer：具有常数成本注意力的选择性循环记忆
translated_abstract: Transformers保留序列的显式历史记录，使注意力机制能够直接检索过去的表示。然而，KV缓存的大小和新token的处理成本会随着上下文长度的增加而增长。状态空间模型将过去压缩为固定大小的循环状态，但代价是降低了对历史信息的可寻址性。我们提出了动态记忆Transformer（DMT），这是一种将序列编码与信息读取分离的混合架构。编码器使用多个记忆单元，每个记忆单元由一个具有复数对角循环矩阵的动力系统实现，并由输入相关的泄漏率控制其更新。随后，解码器使用注意力机制来读取和组合这些记忆单元的输出，而无需遍历token历史。该循环结构的公式化允许使用关联扫描进行计算，总工作复杂度为O(T)，并行深度为O(log T)，且维度保持固定。在自回归推理过程中，循环状态和卷积……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出动态记忆Transformer（DMT）混合架构，利用具有输入相关泄漏率的循环记忆单元进行序列编码，并通过注意力机制直接读取记忆输出，在实现常数推理成本的同时保持对历史信息的高效检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Dynamical Memory Transformer (DMT), a hybrid architecture that encodes sequences through recurrent memory units with input-dependent leak rates and reads them via attention, achieving constant inference cost while preserving efficient access to past information.
